title: Knowledge Source
description: A knowledge source in the company knowledge register.

type.description: Type of memory: semantic (facts), episodic (events), procedural (instructions), evidence (proof).

location.description: Where this source lives: file path, URL, vault name, drive folder.

format.description: File format: markdown, yaml, pdf, google-doc, notion, spreadsheet, other.

owner.description: Person or team responsible for this source.

source_of_truth.description: Whether this is the definitive version of this knowledge.

read_access.description: Who and what can read this source: people, teams, agents, tools.

write_access.description: Who and what can modify this source.

restricted_data.description: Whether this source contains personal, financial, or sensitive data.

review_frequency.description: How often this source is reviewed: weekly, monthly, quarterly.

last_reviewed.description: Date this source was last reviewed.
